sv_matchperfstats_send_to_steam.name: sv_matchperfstats_send_to_steam
sv_matchperfstats_send_to_steam.help: Set to false to disable sending match perf stats to steam

sv_max_queries_sec.name: sv_max_queries_sec
sv_max_queries_sec.help: Maximum queries per second to respond to from a single IP address.

sv_maxvelocity.help: Maximum speed any ballistically moving object is allowed to attain per axis.

sv_merge_changes_after_tick_with_calcdel.help: This fixes bugs where pure calcdelta is used due to recipient changing but it doesn't pick up a field change where the value was changed back to same value as the from snapshot even though the destination fields change list does note the change. sv_minrate.name: sv_minrate

sv_minupdaterate.help: Minimum updates per second that the server will allow

sv_networkvar_validate.help: Validate each StateChanged against known offsets.

sv_noclipduringpause.name: sv_noclipduringpause
sv_noclipduringpause.help: If cheats are enabled, then you can noclip with the game paused (for doing screenshots, etc.).

sv_parallel_checktransmit.help: Set to 1 to use threaded checkentities for transmit/pvs on listen servers, 2 for dedicated servers.

sv_parallel_packentities.help: Set to 1 to use threaded snapshot sending on listen servers, 2 for dedicated servers.

sv_parallel_sendsnapshot.help: 0: run all send jobs on main thread; 1: send jobs run asynchronously (except on dedicated server); 2: send jobs asynchronously; 3: send jobs run in parallel but block to not overlap the next tick; 4: main server clients' send jobs run in parallel, then HLTV server jobs; this approximately matches pre-async profile for a single HLTV server configuration

sv_password.name: sv_password
sv_password.help: Server password for entry into multiplayer games

sv_pause_on_console_open.name: sv_pause_on_console_open

sv_phys_sound_disable_impact_sounds_unde.name: sv_phys_sound_disable_impact_sounds_under_hard_threshold

sv_pvs_max_distance.name: sv_pvs_max_distance
sv_pvs_max_distance.help: if set, adds a maximum range to PVS/PAS checks

sv_recipients_check.name: sv_recipients_check

sv_regeneration_force_on.name: sv_regeneration_force_on
sv_regeneration_force_on.help: Cheat to test regenerative health systems

sv_region.name: sv_region
sv_region.help: The region of the world to report this server in.

sv_replay_group_id.name: sv_replay_group_id

sv_skyname.help: Current name of the skybox texture

sv_snapshot_unlimited.name: sv_snapshot_unlimited

sv_steamauth_enforce.help: By default, player must maintain a reliable connection to Steam servers. When player Steam session drops, enforce it: 2 = instantly kick, 1 = kick at next spawn, 0 = do not kick.

sv_steamauth_ignore_localhost.help: Ignore VAC and auth errors for client connected via localhost address or in-engine loopback

sv_steamgroup_exclusive.name: sv_steamgroup_exclusive
sv_steamgroup_exclusive.help: If set, only members of Steam group will be able to join the server when it's empty, public people will be able to join the server only if it has players.

sv_stopspeed.name: sv_stopspeed

sv_stressbots.name: sv_stressbots

sv_unpause_on_console_close.name: sv_unpause_on_console_close

sys_minidumpspewlines.name: sys_minidumpspewlines

tv_broadcast1.name: tv_broadcast1
tv_broadcast1.help: Automatically broadcasts all games as GOTV[1] demos through Steam.
